dedupeText: mid century country music album layout 1960s country music sans serif typography color block rounded rectangle frame pink and green palette high contrast color blocking between forest green and stark white typographic hierarchy moving from ultra bold display to compact metadata geometric framing of a warm toned candid performance photograph repetition of floral burst graphic motifs to flank the primary title combine a dark color blocked header with ultra condensed type a wide font subtitle and a central framed image for a classic 1960s commercial aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition featuring a heavy green header with bold white and pink typography, a central white field containing a rounded-corner photo of a performer, and a clean white footer for secondary metadata.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast color blocking between forest green and stark white
Typographic hierarchy moving from ultra-bold display to compact metadata
Geometric framing of a warm-toned, candid performance photograph
Repetition of floral-burst graphic motifs to flank the primary title
coreInvariants: Forest green header block occupying the top third
Ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif for the primary name
Pink accent color for the secondary title and graphic flourishes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a medium shot of a musician with a guitar, centered within a rounded rectangular frame in the middle section.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, condensed sans-serif text at the very top acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starts at the bold name, moves to the pink title, scans the tracklist, rests on the central photo, and ends at the bottom metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous white space surrounds the central photo frame, providing breathing room for the dense typography above.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Forest green header background providing a solid base for white text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the central body and primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta-pink for the secondary title and decorative floral icons.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white and saturated pink pop against the dark, muted green and the warm, sepia-toned photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, uniform strokes with minimal counters
Secondary title uses wide, geometric letterforms with high horizontal emphasis
Body text is set in all-caps, tightly tracked sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' in the primary title has a sharp, inward-facing spur
The 'M' has a deep V-crotch reaching the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: pairing an ultra-condensed header with a wide, geometric sub-header.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy weight of the primary name.
Captures the wide, mid-century geometric feel of the secondary title.
Suitable for the tracklist and metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-tier layout. Top tier is a solid forest green rectangle. Middle tier is a white field containing a centered, rounded-corner rectangle frame. Bottom tier is a thin white strip. Inside the middle frame, place a warm-toned, slightly grainy photograph of a man playing an acoustic guitar in a 1960s suit.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed bold white sans-serif text at the top. Below it, add wide magenta-pink sans-serif text flanked by two pink floral icons. Add a cyan logo in the bottom left and small black metadata in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the top text ultra-condensed and white?
Is the secondary title pink and wide?
Is the background of the top section forest green?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the photo frame
postGenerationChecks: Check that no text is overlapping the photo subject's face.
Ensure the green header is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the pink color is vibrant and not muted.
Confirm the tracklist text is small but legible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark color-blocked header with ultra-condensed type, a wide-font subtitle, and a central framed image for a classic 1960s commercial aesthetic.
